venue.name: [Flitwick Village Hall](https://www.flitwickvillagehall.co.uk/community/flitwick-village-hall-19804/home/)
venue.address: Flitwick Village Hall, Dunstable Road, Flitwick, Bedfordshire, MK45 1HP

items.information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**PLEASE NOTE:** This is a Blindfolded specialist competition, there will be no regular speedsolving events held. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above.

**Spectators may attend for free!** However, as this is a blindfolded specialist competition, we will ask for silence during the majority of the event.

The winner of **4x4 Blindfolded** will be announced as the winner of the competition.

items.information:
Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur zweiten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern begrüßen zu dürfen!

We are very excited to welcome you all to the second official speedcubing competition in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern!
